Authenticates an admin user and returns a JWT in the `Authorization`
response header. Extract and store this token for use on all subsequent requests.

Single-session enforcement: if the user already has an active session,
returns `403 Forbidden`. Call `DELETE /api/v1/admin/logout` first to clear it.
